🎬 Materialists (2025)

Materialists follows Lucy, an ambitious and successful matchmaker living in New York City who specializes in helping wealthy clients find their ideal romantic partners. Despite her professional expertise in relationships, Lucy finds herself struggling with her own understanding of love when she becomes caught between two very different men. Harry is a charming, wealthy bachelor who offers her the financial security and luxurious lifestyle she has always desired, while John is her former boyfriend, a struggling actor with whom she shares a deep emotional connection and complicated history. As Lucy navigates this unexpected love triangle, she begins questioning whether true compatibility can be measured through wealth, appearance, and social status or whether genuine happiness comes from something deeper. Starring Dakota Johnson, Pedro Pascal, and Chris Evans, the film delivers thoughtful romance, emotional performances, and compelling storytelling about modern dating, ambition, financial security, vulnerability, and the complicated relationship between love and money.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Comedy • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 56m • R

🎥 Director: Celine Song

✍️ Writer: Celine Song

🎬 Distributor: A24

📍 Setting: New York City.

source_details.synopsis: Materialists is a 2025 American romantic comedy-drama film written and directed by Celine Song and starring Dakota Johnson, Chris Evans, and Pedro Pascal. The film follows a matchmaker, her ex-boyfriend, and a wealthy financier amid New York City's competitive dating scene. It is Song's second feature film, following Past Lives (2023), and was produced by Killer Films and 2AM. Materialists was released in the United States on June 13, 2025, by A24. The film received generally positive reviews and grossed $108 million on a $20 million budget.
